assumptions: Scenario assumptions, not consensus or observed multiples. FY2027 is the disclosed 53-week period. GAAP diluted EPS cases are annual: bear $8.50, base $9.50, bull $10.50. They begin with reported GAAP H1 EPS of $4.85 and therefore imply remaining H2 EPS of $3.65/$4.65/$5.65, using a constant-share approximation only; actual diluted shares may differ. The Q3 revenue outlook is $108.0bn ±2% with no China Data Center compute revenue assumed, but it gives no EPS guidance; Q4 is a disclosed 14-week quarter. Bear tests weaker conversion of AI-system demand and/or margin or supply/policy friction; base assumes the Q3 revenue outlook and continuing demand support H2 earnings above the H1 run rate; bull assumes stronger execution and demand into the 14-week Q4. P/E assumptions are 18x/24x/30x, explicit hypothetical stresses rather than fair, normal, current, or probable multiples.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
